questions.stem:
Guide: Stay close to the group. The path gets tricky ahead.

What does 'tricky' mean here?
questions.explanation: Tricky means difficult or requiring care.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "We got lost but managed to find our way back before dark." What can we infer?
options: They faced a challenge but overcame it.
questions.explanation: They overcame the challenge of being lost.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Hiker: How much further to the summit?

Guide: We're about halfway there.

What does the guide mean?
options: We have completed half the distance.
questions.explanation: Halfway means half the distance is done.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "The weather took a turn for the worse." What probably happened?
questions.explanation: Took a turn for the worse means conditions got bad.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Friend: I've never tried rock climbing before.

You: ---

Which response is encouraging?
options: Everyone starts somewhere. The instructors will help you—you'll do great!
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "We had to pitch our tent in the rain." What did they do?
options: They set up their tent despite the rain.
questions.explanation: Pitch means to set up (a tent).
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: Read: "The view from the top was worth every step." What does the writer suggest?
options: The effort was rewarded by the experience.
questions.explanation: Worth every step means the effort paid off.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "Pack light—you'll thank yourself later." What is the advice?
options: Take only what you need to avoid heavy loads.
questions.explanation: Pack light means take minimal, essential items.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Leader: We need to stick together. No one goes off alone.

Why might this rule exist?
options: For safety—to avoid getting lost or injured alone.
questions.explanation: Sticking together reduces risk when outdoors.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "We made it back before the storm hit." What were they avoiding?
questions.explanation: They returned before the storm arrived.
questions.subject: ing
